description: User-created skill cards exposed edit, delete, and enable/disable as controls without naming the target slash skill.
expected: Skill card actions should be named with the target skill, such as `Edit /code-review`, `Delete /code-review`, and `Disable /code-review`.
actual: After creating `/bad-name`, the card exposed two unlabeled buttons and a generic `Disable skill` switch.
suggested_fix: Add per-skill accessible labels to the edit, delete, and enabled switch controls.

criterion: Destructive actions confirm in app context
description: Deleting a skill used a native browser confirmation instead of an in-app confirmation state.
expected: The delete action should present visible in-app Confirm and Cancel controls near the destructive action.
actual: The delete path relied on `window.confirm`, which is inconsistent with nearby settings flows and hard to inspect or automate in the app UI.
suggested_fix: Replace the native confirmation with inline Confirm/Cancel controls on the skill card.
